Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production enemy sprite atlas PNG for an original Godot GemTD-inspired game. Image 1 is our approved ENEMY ATLAS v1 and determines pixel scale, lighting, outlines and limited palette: match it exactly so the new creatures sit beside it. Image 2 is a LAYOUT AND IDENTITY GUIDE ONLY: it shows which creature goes in which cell and its rough body shape and pose; do not copy its simpler rendering, redraw every creature in the style of image 1. Create a perfectly regular 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet, aspect ratio 4:3, ideally 1280x960. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete isolated creature, centered with lots of transparent padding (at least 15% cell width each side), ground creatures' feet on the same local baseline, flying creatures hovering slightly above it with wings spread. Genuine transparent alpha background. No backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels, borders, numbers, ground tiles or scenery. Same chunky crisp pixel-art technique as image 1: dark near-black outlines, solid pixel clusters, top-left light, warm highlights and rich restrained colors. Camera viewed down at top/front; creatures face diagonally down-right. Roughly 40x40 logical pixel density, enlarged crisp edges, no smooth painting, blur or photorealism. Tiny gameplay silhouettes must be distinct. All creatures are original designs inspired by the descriptions, not copied Dota models. Empty cells stay fully transparent.

layout_correction: Edit only sprite layout and scale. Preserve every creature's design, identity, details, palette and pixel-art rendering. Keep exactly the same 1448x1086 transparent RGBA canvas, an exact 4-column x 3-row invisible grid with square 362x362 cells. CRITICAL production fix: every complete sprite including wings, ears, tails, horns and accessories MUST be wholly inside its OWN cell, with at least 55px transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides of that cell. Shrink sprites uniformly as needed to a maximum 252x252px bounding box, never crop. Cell centers x=181,543,905,1267; row centers y=181,543,905. Thus allowed sprite boxes: column1 x55..307; column2 x417..669; column3 x779..1031; column4 x1141..1393. Row1 y55..307; row2 y417..669; row3 y779..1031. Center each sprite in its allowed box. Match ground sprites' local feet baseline at y307,669,1031 respectively. Leave all gaps and existing empty cells genuinely fully transparent, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no text. Retain exactly the original reading order. Do not enlarge sprites to fill the atlas. Maintain chunky crisp pixel clusters and dark outline.

final_corrections.b: Production sprite atlas layout correction. Preserve the exact twelve character designs, style and reading order of this image, with genuine transparent background, 4 columns and 3 equally tall rows. The top four characters' feet currently cross the boundary at one third of the image height. Move ONLY the four TOP ROW sprites UPWARD by 70 pixels, leaving their size unchanged. Their bottoms must be near y=300 and absolutely above y=320 on this approximately 1448x1086 canvas. Leave row 2 and row 3 characters exactly where they are. Keep the entire horizontal strip y=320..415 completely transparent alpha=0 so cell cropping cannot cut through the first row characters. Clean isolated stray low-opacity pixels in all transparent gaps. No lines, no checkerboard, no text. All pixels in transparent gaps must have alpha exactly zero.
final_corrections.c: Clean up transparency ONLY on this production sprite atlas. Preserve exactly the eight complete sprites in their existing 4-column 2-row positions, all details and pixel style. Preserve the full approximately 1448x1086 canvas and invisible 4-column by 3-row grid. The third/bottom row has no sprites and must be COMPLETELY transparent with alpha exactly zero at every pixel. Remove all faint residual alpha noise from the entire bottom third of the canvas (y>=724) and from all gaps outside the eight creatures. All transparent background pixels must have alpha exactly 0; no haze, no low-opacity residue, no ground shadows, no checkerboard, no text. Do not resize or move or redraw the eight creatures. All visible art must end above y=710.

inspection.notes: Selected generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte. Near-4:3 output; crop boundaries use round() as in refine.py. No animation or runtime binding changed.
